cutoff_source: unchanged old square-L512 count cutoffs, as in completion-hazard-production-20260929
primary: overlap-weighted early-minus-late mean safe-insertion completion increment Y within exact (primitive direction,integer nu_b)
primary_eligibility: nu_b<N-b; cells with nu_b=N-b have no safe conditional step and are separately counted
sampling: independent uniform site permutations; four with-replacement uniform safe-site probes in separate copies of each rank-one prefix, selected by vacancy rejection using a distinct RNG stream
probe_unit: one original prefix; average its four increments before inference, never treat them as independent configurations
weights: w=n_early*n_late/(n_early+n_late) on common exact cells; normalize over cells and recompute all support and weights on aligned whole-batch deletion
mechanistic_map: in each cell, Delta mean e=(N-b-nu_b)*DeltaY/2, Delta two-step survival=-(N-b-nu_b)*DeltaY/[(N-b)*(N-b-1)]
secondary: independent replication of the previously retrospective exact-direction weighted mean nu_b contrast; all rank-one prefixes, including any with no safe step
model_prediction: (rank,direction,nu) weak Markov closure requires the primary cohort contrast to be zero. Nonzero population contrast violates a necessary condition; an unresolved contrast does not establish full closure. No prospective sign assumed from L4 because square/triangular signs differ.
analysis: one fixed primary mean; full aligned 14-batch delete-one covariance with derived edge/two-step contrasts and declared secondary; no old/new pooling, cutoff/feature/subgroup search, result-dependent sample extension, or exponent fitting
benchmark: 32 new excluded prefixes, runtime only, separate seed role; anticipated ideal-parallel production time must not exceed 900 seconds to start this block
scope: one lattice, one existing size and count clock; no direct finite-window-survival replacement, original-U identification or continuum certificate
